purpose: Read-only compiler frontier check for the live PyPI provenance audit.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
p=root/'canonical/runtime/goal_compiler.py'
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gcprov',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
reg=json.loads((root/'canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json').read_text())['capabilities']
goal=json.loads((root/'canonical/astra_runtime/missions/ASTRA_RUNTIME_LIVE_PROVENANCE_AUDIT_001.json').read_text())['goal']
try:
 out=m.compile_goal(goal,reg,root); print(json.dumps({'status':'COMPILED','modes':[x['mode'] for x in out.get('compiled_parts',[])],'parts':out.get('compiled_parts')},sort_keys=True))
except Exception as e:
 print(json.dumps({'status':'FAILED','type':type(e).__name__,'code':getattr(e,'code',None),'detail':getattr(e,'detail',None),'error':str(e)},sort_keys=True))
print('LIVE_PROVENANCE_COMPILER_DIAG_COMPLETE')
PY
